system.one_liner: A survey of hallucination in Video LLMs with a taxonomy of two types, dynamic distortion and content fabrication, each with two subtypes.

content.variant_note: an image-level hallucination example at left behind a dashed divider, and at right a two-colour taxonomy of video hallucinations whose four cards each show one failure on a frame strip
content.argues: Video LLMs show hallucination types beyond static image errors: dynamic distortion and content fabrication, each with two subtypes illustrated by a wrong caption on a clip.
content.subject: image-level hallucination versus a 2 by 2 taxonomy of video hallucinations, each type with frames and the model's wrong sentence

elements.name: Dynamic Distortion
elements.role: category (1): hallucinations that distort how the video moves or who is who
elements.drawn_as: pale blue rounded region with a blue-grey title, holding two cards

elements.name: Spatialtemporal Dynamic Hallucination
elements.role: subtype: spatiotemporal misrepresentation, e.g. reporting 'The person is STANDING UP' when the person sits down
elements.drawn_as: blue card with a clock-and-scrambled-arrows icon, three frames T1 to T3, a down arrow and a caption box

elements.name: Referential Inconsistency
elements.role: subtype: the referent changes, e.g. 'The man CHANGES INTO BLUE CLOTHES' when a woman appears
elements.drawn_as: blue card with an icon of two avatars and a broken chain, three frames, a down arrow and a caption box

elements.name: Content Fabrication
elements.role: category (2): hallucinated content that the video does not show
elements.drawn_as: pale orange rounded region with an orange title, holding two cards

elements.name: Context-Driven Fabrication
elements.role: subtype: hallucination driven by statistical priors, e.g. a party scene leads to 'LOUDLY SINGING HAPPY BIRTHDAY'
elements.drawn_as: orange card with a brain icon dotted to a birthday cake, three frames, a down arrow and a caption box

elements.name: Audio-Visual Conflict
elements.role: subtype: audio overrides visual evidence, e.g. 'DOG IS HOWLING LOUDLY' while only a cat is seen
elements.drawn_as: orange card with a megaphone and faded eye icon, three frames over a black waveform, a down arrow and a caption box

elements.name: hallucinated captions
elements.role: the model's wrong sentence under each card, with the hallucinated words in red capitals
elements.drawn_as: black rounded boxes with bold text and red capital spans

lessons.what_to_learn: Teach a failure taxonomy with one card per type: a concept icon, a three-frame strip with time labels, an arrow and the model's wrong sentence with the hallucinated words in red capitals; put the familiar image-level case at the left behind a dashed divider so the new video types read as an extension.
lessons.suits: survey or position papers that introduce a taxonomy of failure types and need one concrete, readable example for each type.

evidence: Video models exhibit unique hallucination types beyond static errors in images.
which includes hallucinations influenced by statistical priors and cases where auditory input overrides visual evidence
a systematic taxonomy that categorizes them into two core types: dynamic distortion and content fabrication

summary: This survey organises hallucinations in video LLMs into two core types, dynamic distortion and content fabrication, each with two subtypes. Figure 1 is the taxonomy with one example per subtype. At left, an image-level case sets the baseline: a cat photo and the caption 'A cat is sleeping on a red rug, facing right' with attribute, object and relation errors tagged by red arrows. At right, two coloured regions hold two cards each: blue for Spatialtemporal Dynamic Hallucination and Referential Inconsistency, orange for Context-Driven Fabrication and Audio-Visual Conflict. A card pairs a concept icon with a three-frame strip (T1 to T3) and the model's wrong sentence with the hallucinated words in red capitals.
summary_zh: 这篇综述把视频大模型的幻觉分为动态失真和内容编造两类、各含两个子类。图一左侧用图像幻觉作基线，右侧蓝、橙两个区域各放两张卡片，每张含概念图标、T1 到 T3 三帧画面和把幻觉词标红的错误描述。
notes: No paragraph mentions the figure, so roles come from the caption, the abstract and the drawing. Prior kinds kept (scope-overview as taxonomy-map, side-by-side-contrast for image versus video). Whether the captions and clips are real model outputs is not stated; they are judged illustrative (real_values false). The tags Attr. Hal, Obj. Hal and Rel. Hal are read as attribute, object and relation hallucination; the figure does not spell them out. The card title reads Spatialtemporal Dynamic Hallucination while the caption says spatiotemporal misrepresentation.
